demo.cliff: tonnage is three numbers, not one
teaches: tonnage is a triple — tons, percent and minimum — because a component may be a flat figure, a share of the hull, or a share with a floor.
power and powerPerTon are the same choice for the power draw, and both are read.
rating is the component's own grade: how many tons of fuel this one refines in a day.
tl on a component is a number, unlike every other Item type, where it is the string TL12.
demo.trap: dm is a grade rather than a modifier the sheet adds up. A component that improves a check states it here, and the ship reads it when the check is made — writing it as if it were a bonus on the component itself changes nothing.

system.description: Skims and refines what the scoops take. Two days on a gas giant and the tank is clean.
